messages:
devon: Quick design review — updated the Playground conversation footer. Trying a compact token band + grouped Stop/Regenerate controls. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXXX/playground-footer (updated frames 3–5) :eyes:
figma-bot: Miranda updated 'playground/footer' — 5 frames, comments: 4 new.
aisha: Nice. First thought: token band looks cleaner but worried about discoverability for Stop vs Regenerate. Keyboard users? :keyboard:
sam: Agree. Also we should decide on copy: 'Stop' vs 'Stop generating' — shorter is better for tight UI but explicit is clearer.
miranda: Quick hallway test with 6 folks: 4 expected Stop to be leftmost control, 2 looked for regen in overflow. Recommendation: primary action = Stop (left) then Regenerate (right) as a secondary.
devon: Proposed layout (ASCII):
```
[Conversation area]
---------------------- footer ----------------------
| [token band ▲]   | [Stop] [Regenerate ↻] | [Prompt drawer ▾] |
----------------------------------------------------
```
Token band collapses to an icon by default, expands on click/keyboard.
aisha: Accessibility nits: ensure token band exposes `role=progressbar` and `aria-valuetext` for current token count. Visible focus ring for keyboard users. Contrast on small text is low on the mock.
sam: For token counter UX: collapse to an icon with accessible label, but expose live updates via `aria-live="polite"` when token count changes. Tooltip on hover for mouse users. For mobile, keep expanded by default? Might depend on viewport.
miranda: Prompt library: add 'Save selection to library' in message actions and allow drag -> prompt shelf. Also add a light preview when hovering over a library item.
ux-bot: Accessibility checklist reminder: https://redwood-internal/ux/a11y-checklist — keyboard focus order, ARIA labels, color contrast check, screen reader text for icons.
sam: Copy proposal: keep button text terse: 'Stop' and 'Regenerate'. Tooltip/aria-description can be longer: 'Stop generating this response' / 'Regenerate response using same prompt'.
aisha: Small implementation note: for focus order, make sure Stop is focusable before Regenerate and the Prompt drawer trigger is last. Add `aria-controls` to token band expansion.
devon: Decision for this pass: Move Stop to the left, Regenerate to the right with a compact ↻ icon, token band collapsed by default but expandable. Prompt library entry point remains right-most. Action items: devon -> update Figma frames and annotate a11y; aisha -> open accessibility PR with focus behaviors and ARIA; sam -> prototype front-end interactions (keyboard + expand); miranda -> adjust copy & add prompt save affordance. :white_check_mark:
aisha: I'll open the PR today and link it here.
sam: I'll throw up a simple prototype branch by EOD and ping for review.
miranda: I'll update the Figma copy and leave comments on hover states.
devon: Thanks all :rocket: If nobody objects I'll ship the Figma updates and we can start implementation next sprint.
